title: InnoLive 실사용
description: 스트리머 실사용 기록(#266). 정의는 scripts/usage/report.sql과 같다.

list.name: min_minutes
list.label: 최소 방송 시간(분)
list.description: 이보다 짧은 방송 회차는 모든 패널에서 뺀다. 테스트성 짧은 송출을 걸러낼 때 올린다.

panels.title: 요약 (선택 기간)
panels.description: 방송 회차 = 송출이 있었던 세션(동시 송출은 1회차). 방송 시간은 라이브 전환부터, 일시정지 제외.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT b.session_id, s.user_id, b.provider,
         COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at) AS start_at, b.ended_at,
         GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.ended_at - COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at)) - b.paused_seconds, 0) AS sec
  FROM usage_broadcasts b
  JOIN usage_sessions s USING (session_id)
), all_rounds AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         MIN(user_id::text)::uuid AS user_id,
         MIN(start_at)            AS round_start,
         MAX(ended_at)            AS round_end,
         COALESCE(SUM(sec), 0)    AS sec,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT provider, '+' ORDER BY provider) AS platforms
  FROM b
  GROUP BY session_id
), r AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_rounds WHERE sec >= $min_minutes * 60
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)                                        AS "방송한 계정",
       COUNT(*)                                                        AS "방송 회차",
       ROUND((SUM(sec) / 3600)::numeric, 1)                           AS "총 방송 시간(h)",
       ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sec) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "방송 중앙값(분)",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
          SELECT user_id FROM r
          WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(round_start)
          GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round_start::date) >= 2) t) AS "2일 이상 방송한 계정"
FROM r
WHERE $__timeFilter(round_start)

panels.title: 주별 방송한 계정 (신규 / 재방문)
panels.description: 신규 = 그 주가 첫 방송인 계정. 첫 방송 주는 기간과 무관하게 전체 기록에서 정한다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT b.session_id, s.user_id, b.provider,
         COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at) AS start_at, b.ended_at,
         GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.ended_at - COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at)) - b.paused_seconds, 0) AS sec
  FROM usage_broadcasts b
  JOIN usage_sessions s USING (session_id)
), all_rounds AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         MIN(user_id::text)::uuid AS user_id,
         MIN(start_at)            AS round_start,
         MAX(ended_at)            AS round_end,
         COALESCE(SUM(sec), 0)    AS sec,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT provider, '+' ORDER BY provider) AS platforms
  FROM b
  GROUP BY session_id
), r AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_rounds WHERE sec >= $min_minutes * 60
), weekly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', round_start) AS week
  FROM r WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
), first_week AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(week) AS first_week FROM weekly GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(w.week, 'YYYY-MM-DD')               AS "주",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.week = f.first_week) AS "신규",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.week > f.first_week) AS "재방문"
FROM weekly w JOIN first_week f USING (user_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(w.week)
GROUP BY w.week
ORDER BY w.week

WITH b AS (
  SELECT b.session_id, s.user_id, b.provider,
         COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at) AS start_at, b.ended_at,
         GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.ended_at - COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at)) - b.paused_seconds, 0) AS sec
  FROM usage_broadcasts b
  JOIN usage_sessions s USING (session_id)
), all_rounds AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         MIN(user_id::text)::uuid AS user_id,
         MIN(start_at)            AS round_start,
         MAX(ended_at)            AS round_end,
         COALESCE(SUM(sec), 0)    AS sec,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT provider, '+' ORDER BY provider) AS platforms
  FROM b
  GROUP BY session_id
), r AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_rounds WHERE sec >= $min_minutes * 60
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', round_start)        AS time,
       ROUND((SUM(sec) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "방송 시간(h)",
       COUNT(*)                              AS "방송 회차"
FROM r
WHERE $__timeFilter(round_start)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 계정별
panels.description: 이메일은 users 테이블에서 가져온다. 탈퇴한 계정은 집계에서 빠진다(user_id NULL).

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT b.session_id, s.user_id, b.provider,
         COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at) AS start_at, b.ended_at,
         GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.ended_at - COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at)) - b.paused_seconds, 0) AS sec
  FROM usage_broadcasts b
  JOIN usage_sessions s USING (session_id)
), all_rounds AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         MIN(user_id::text)::uuid AS user_id,
         MIN(start_at)            AS round_start,
         MAX(ended_at)            AS round_end,
         COALESCE(SUM(sec), 0)    AS sec,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT provider, '+' ORDER BY provider) AS platforms
  FROM b
  GROUP BY session_id
), r AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_rounds WHERE sec >= $min_minutes * 60
), gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, round_start,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM round_start - LAG(round_end) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY round_start)) / 3600 AS gap_h
  FROM r WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
), sessions AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS n,
         SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at)) / 3600 AS h
  FROM usage_sessions
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(u.email, s.user_id::text)                                   AS "계정",
       u.display_name                                                        AS "이름",
       s.n                                                                   AS "접속",
       ROUND(s.h::numeric, 1)                                                AS "접속 시간(h)",
       COUNT(r.session_id)                                                   AS "방송 회차",
       ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(r.sec), 0) / 3600)::numeric, 1)                   AS "방송 시간(h)",
       ROUND((AVG(r.sec) / 60)::numeric, 1)                                  AS "평균 방송(분)",
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(g.gap_h)::numeric, 1) FROM gaps g
         WHERE g.user_id = s.user_id AND $__timeFilter(g.round_start))       AS "평균 방송 간격(h)",
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.round_start::date)                                   AS "방송한 날",
       MIN(r.round_start)                                                    AS "첫 방송",
       MAX(r.round_start)                                                    AS "마지막 방송"
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.user_id = s.user_id AND $__timeFilter(r.round_start)
GROUP BY s.user_id, u.email, u.display_name, s.n, s.h
ORDER BY "방송 회차" DESC, "접속" DESC

panels.title: 회차별 — 직전 방송 이후 몇 시간 만인가
panels.description: 간격이 수 분 이내면 네트워크 끊김 후 재접속일 가능성이 크다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT b.session_id, s.user_id, b.provider,
         COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at) AS start_at, b.ended_at,
         GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.ended_at - COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at)) - b.paused_seconds, 0) AS sec
  FROM usage_broadcasts b
  JOIN usage_sessions s USING (session_id)
), all_rounds AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         MIN(user_id::text)::uuid AS user_id,
         MIN(start_at)            AS round_start,
         MAX(ended_at)            AS round_end,
         COALESCE(SUM(sec), 0)    AS sec,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT provider, '+' ORDER BY provider) AS platforms
  FROM b
  GROUP BY session_id
), r AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_rounds WHERE sec >= $min_minutes * 60
), ordered AS (
  SELECT r.*,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM round_start - LAG(round_end) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY round_start)) / 3600 AS gap_h
  FROM r WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT o.round_start                              AS "시작",
       COALESCE(u.email, o.user_id::text)         AS "계정",
       ROUND((o.sec / 60)::numeric, 1)            AS "방송(분)",
       o.platforms                                AS "플랫폼",
       ROUND(o.gap_h::numeric, 1)                 AS "직전 방송 이후(h)"
FROM ordered o
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.round_start)
ORDER BY o.round_start DESC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT b.session_id, s.user_id, b.provider,
         COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at) AS start_at, b.ended_at,
         GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.ended_at - COALESCE(b.live_at, b.started_at)) - b.paused_seconds, 0) AS sec
  FROM usage_broadcasts b
  JOIN usage_sessions s USING (session_id)
), all_rounds AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         MIN(user_id::text)::uuid AS user_id,
         MIN(start_at)            AS round_start,
         MAX(ended_at)            AS round_end,
         COALESCE(SUM(sec), 0)    AS sec,
         STRING_AGG(DISTINCT provider, '+' ORDER BY provider) AS platforms
  FROM b
  GROUP BY session_id
), r AS (
  SELECT * FROM all_rounds WHERE sec >= $min_minutes * 60
)
SELECT platforms AS "플랫폼", COUNT(*) AS "회차"
FROM r
WHERE $__timeFilter(round_start)
GROUP BY platforms
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 송출 종료 사유
panels.description: user_requested = 사용자가 종료. rtmp_reconnect_exhausted 등은 장애. session_closed는 앱/연결 종료와 함께 끝난 송출(백필분은 추정).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(end_reason, '(열림)') AS "사유", COUNT(*) AS "송출"
FROM usage_broadcasts
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
